path: Technical Skills > AI and Automation > AI Fundamentals
new_description: Discover the exciting world of artificial intelligence! In this fun learning adventure, you'll get to explore how computers can see, hear, and think like humans. You'll find out how robots can move and do amazing things, and learn about the special 'brains' that make it all possible. With hands-on activities and engaging stories, you'll dive into the fascinating world of AI and come away with a new understanding of how technology can be designed to help people.
focus_areas: computer vision, speech recognition, problem-solving algorithms, robot movement and control

name: AI and Automation
new_description: Explore the fascinating world of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation! Learn how computers and robots can be programmed to think, see, and act like humans. Discover the amazing technologies that power self-driving cars, digital assistants, and robots that can do complex tasks. Dive into the science behind machine learning, where computers use data to teach themselves new skills. Understand how AI systems can recognize patterns, make decisions, and even be creative. Get excited about the future as you learn how AI and automation are transforming industries and changing the way we live.
focus_areas: machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, robotics, intelligent systems

name: Business Strategy & Analysis
new_description: Explore the intricacies of business strategy and decision-making through the lens of data-driven analysis. Delve into the fundamental principles of economics, organizational behavior, and management that shape an organization's competitive positioning and long-term success. Gain insights into how leaders assess market trends, evaluate performance metrics, and formulate strategic plans to navigate complex business environments.
focus_areas: Market Analysis, Competitive Strategy, Financial Modeling, Organizational Design, Strategic Planning
